N. of Śiva, MW.
of a son of Atri, VāyuP.
शानी f. a sort of cucumber or colocynth, L.

सं-नि-√ शम् (only ind.p. -शाम्य or -शम्य), to perceive, hear, learn, MBh.; Kathās.
सं-निश्चय m. a settled opinion (acc. with √ या, ‘to make up one's mind’), MBh.
सं-नि-श्रय m. (√ श्रि) support (see किम्-स्˚).
सं-निश्रित mfn. connected with, devoted to, Divyāv.
सं-नि-षद् (√ सद्) to sink or sit down, AV.; MBh.
सं-निषण्ण mfn. settled down, seated, R.
halted, stationary, W.
सं-नि-षिच् (√ सिच्) P. -षिञ्चति to pour into, MBh.
सं-नि-षेवित mfn. (√ सेव्) served, frequented, inhabited by (instr.), MBh.
सं-निषेव्य mfn. to be attended to or treated medically, MBh.
सं-नि-सूदित mfn. (√ सूद्) altogether killed, destroyed, MBh. (B. -षूदित).
सं-नि-सृष्ट mfn. (√ सृज्) delivered up or over, intrusted, committed, MBh.
सं-निहती f. N. of a river, Prāyaśc.
of a Tīrtha, MBh.
सं-निहन n. (used to explain सं-निहती), MBh.
सं-नि-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to strike at, strike, kill, MBh.
सानिन् mfn. gaining, procuring (ifc.), Nir.
सानिका f. (of unknown derivation) a flute, pipe, L.
सानिबाप (of unknown meaning), Pañcad.

सांनिध्य n. (fr. सं-निधि) the being near, nearness, vicinity, presence, attendance (acc. with √ कृ, ‘to make one's appearance, be or become present’; with Caus. of √ कृ, ‘to cause to be near, call near’; with √ या, or √ व्रज् ‘to come near, approach’; -पक्षे-√ जन् with gen., ‘to take the place of’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
सांनिध्य—तस् ind. from proximity, Mālatīm.
सांनिध्य—ता f. vicinity, neighbourhood, Hariv.
सांनिपातिक—कर्मन् n. the treatment of the above illness, Kāv.; Suśr.
miscellaneous, promiscuous, collective, W.
सांनिवेशिक mfn. = सं-निवेशम् समवैति, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 43, Sch.
सांनिहित्य n. (fr. सं-निहित) close vicinity, anything near at hand, Saṃskārak.
सनिस्रसाक्ष॑ mfn. one whose eyes fall out, ib.
